BiblicalUsage: Ezra is told to appoint judges who know the laws of God, and to let judgment be executed speedily on any who will not obey.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe judgment that is slow is no judgment, and Ezra's judges are my picture of a law that means what it says.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
